content:
Context: 9. Relaxations / Concessions in Promotions.-

- (viii) Retention of SC/ST status by meritorious candidates.SC/ST candidates appointed on their own merit (by direct recruitment or promotion) and adjusted against unreserved points will retain their status of SC/ST and will be eligible to get benefit of reservation in future/ further promotions, if any.  
- Order 12, Section 1.
